name: Grid
purpose: Arrange content on tokenized two-dimensional tracks with public column, row, gap, and item-placement controls.
useWhen: Content needs coordinated rows and columns or responsive card tracks.

avoidWhen.condition: The layout has one primary row or column.

composition: Choose Grid tracks from the minimum readable child size; use Grid.Item placement only when source order remains meaningful.

rules.statement: Keep DOM order meaningful; visual placement must not create a confusing keyboard or reading sequence.
Use responsive columns, gaps, unanchored spans, and alignment when the same authored Grid changes at Brick breakpoints; keep explicit line starts and ends static.
Use Grid.Item asChild when an existing link, Surface, or component should itself receive placement; provide exactly one element and preserve its native semantics.
Load styles.css or core.css plus grid.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Keeping too many columns until cards become unreadably narrow.
commonMistakes.correction: Reduce columns at the content's real minimum width, not at a device-name breakpoint.

commonMistakes.mistake: Combining a responsive Item span with explicit line placement.
commonMistakes.correction: Let the responsive item auto-place, or keep one deliberate static line placement.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding a Grid.Item wrapper and height CSS around an element that should itself stretch as the grid item.
commonMistakes.correction: Compose that one element with Grid.Item asChild.

validation: Test intrinsic sizing, overflow, zoom, narrow widths, source order, and RTL.
Confirm each child remains readable before and after track changes.
